To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a load management solution to address power grid supply shortage by profiling customers' load behavior and dividing them into groups, and developed an optimization model to perform the load management analysis subject to the customers' participation strategies and other load management constrains.

the developed load management solution is a customer-centric load shaving approach that optimally reduces the system peak load while increasing the system valley load by using a customer profiling-based optimal load management strategy.
our proposed load management solution is able to reduce peak load by 5.6 MW and increase valley load by 5 MW, which could avoid a predicted peak hour power supply shortage of 10 MW.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an optimal load shaving solution for a power grid to avoid the supply shortage problem.
the development of the optimal load management model and solution to address the ever-increasing supply shortage of the power grid.
the development of a load shaving solution for a power grid based on the customer load behavior profiling and load management decision making.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed load management strategy and optimization model can be used to optimally reduce peak load and increase valley load to address the ever increasing supply shortage problem.
the developed solution is a new approach that provides a systematic method for the power system load management and load shedding to address the power supply shortage problem.
the developed solution is a viable and practical solution that can be applied to the real power grid.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a customer profile-based load management solution is developed to address the ever increasing peak hour demand and supply shortage problem.
the developed customer load management solution could be utilized by the power utility to reduce the peak load and increase load during valley hours.
the developed solution provides a new and innovative approach for the load management process of a power grid, especially for the smart grid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the developed load shaving optimization solution can be applied in any power system with advanced metering infrastructure to manage the power supply shortage problem.
the proposed customer profiling based load shaving solution could provide a more effective and reliable load management decision than the existing load management solutions.
the developed load management solution is a viable solution to help the power grid operator to manage the system load in a way that the predicted supply shortage could be reduced and/or avoided.
